template.title: Thank the Hype Train
template.description: When a Hype Train ends, thanks chat with the level it reached and the top contributor. Hype Trains need an Affiliate or Partner channel.

one_of: Hype Train level ${event.payload.level}! Thank you all, and especially ${event.payload.?top_contributor.name.orValue("everyone")} 🚂💜
What a ride: level ${event.payload.level}! Thanks for the hype, chat 🚂
